d_preserved_statement: The child still performs the real judgment: committing to one of 4 diagnosis candidates via an explicit 'これだと思う' action (never pre-filled or suggested by the system) and independently selecting which of the 6 gathered findings are the actual decisive evidence for it. Both are scored together only after the child's own submission; the system never reveals the correct diagnosis or evidence set before that point (verified by gameplay-qa-clue-join.mjs's CORRECT_DIAGNOSIS pre-commit-hint and answer-leak checks). This mirrors the real differential-diagnosis structure preserved through c_compression/game_translations: match findings against candidate patterns, commit to the best-fitting one, and be able to say why.
